prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Barium (바륨) itself — the sovereign of the Barium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: barium: a soft silvery alkaline-earth metal named from Greek barys, heavy, after barite, the startlingly heavy white spar of barium sulfate; around 1600 a shoemaker-alchemist roasted pebbles of it into the Bologna stone, which drank in sunlight and glowed in the dark; the metal was freed in 1808; its salts burn apple green in fireworks; a chalk-white drink of insoluble barium sulfate blocks X-rays and shows the hidden inside of the body in shadow; so like radium that radium was first separated from ore together with barium. Palette: heavy ivory white, apple green flame, warm terracotta brick, soft ember glow.

World (fixed): year 2200, a deep-sea drilling citadel: towers driving their bores miles under the sea floor, held steady by pouring heavy white barite mud that presses back the deep pressure by sheer weight, breakwaters built of great tabular white barite crystals, apple-green signal lights along the decks. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a sleek armored bodysuit — thin, long plates on the shoulders, arms and legs that follow her curves closely; 2) heavy assault bulk — big, thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on the back and legs, while the torso stays fitted and the waist narrow; 3) several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; 4) complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where EXPOSURE allows, dense visible seams and joints; 5) a slender torso with oversized mechanical forearms and lower legs — huge gauntlets and boots — the contrast is the main shape; 6) mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight's plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows; 7) ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles, with light body armor — the floating rings make the shape. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): heavy ivory white, apple green flame, warm terracotta brick, soft ember glow.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): heavy ivory-white hair with a pale apple-green sheen. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ba) and atomic number (56) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Resolved original design: choose silhouette 7, rigid ring-shaped armor bands floating around waist and ankles with light fitted body armor. The rings are thick segmented tabular barite ballast blocks with apple-green magnetic joint lights; they function like heavy pressure stabilizers, with terracotta metal undersides and an ember chest core. Whole body covered in hard ivory mecha plates except symmetrical open shoulder/upper-arm areas and a deep chest window; intimate areas covered, no cloth. Adult woman with softly rounded diamond face, warm beige skin, large sapphire-blue eyes and an assured small smile; ivory-white hair with pale apple-green sheen in two long straight ponytails. Both human hands empty and visible, five fingers each; arms slightly outward, feet planted on a wet citadel deck. Deep-sea drilling towers behind a great clear pressure dome, white barite ramparts and apple-green deck lights. Full body with complete rings and boots visible, face-level camera, natural portrait perspective. Keep fixed style and composition.

generation.note: Original PNG retained in deliverables; repository stores WebP and SHA256 only. No regeneration after output.
